verdict.rationale: Cursor CLI is well documented as a terminal-native coding agent: installable via curl script, interactive and headless/print modes, JSON/stream-json output, permission tokens, CI/GitHub Actions usage, and ACP support for custom clients — clearly enabling local terminal agent runs. missing for 10: independent/hands-on community confirmation of the CLI's day-to-day reliability (community evidence in this pack focuses on the IDE/editor experience, not the CLI specifically).
